reason: Accessible-name props required by contract (spec 027 S15-S16), cumulative since baseline 0.0.0 and superseding declaration a11y-contrast-floor (its deltas, and those of every declaration it supersedes, remain as declared there). The public type narrows from string | undefined to string and required flips to true, so the generated JSX types, the React wrappers and the Angular proxies (required inputs) now demand the prop at compile time; the gate classifies a narrowed type as MAJOR and the cumulative delta since 0.0.0 was already MAJOR. No runtime behavior of any component changes: an element without label still renders exactly as before. The Custom Elements Manifest additionally carries required: true on those attributes and fields (an extension field the catalog derives from), and llms.txt prints the narrowed type. Description-only delta on top (spec 027 S17-S18): ki-indicator count and current document the bounds they declare with @minimum and @maximum (count 0 to 20, current 1 to 20), which the manifest carries as minimum and maximum on those attributes and fields; the component's own normalization is unchanged. Zero removals, no root growth, no CSS or token change. Nothing is published yet (0.0.0, private).
